pages.scan: Top-left: Ravi (upper right of the panel) says 'Good morning! I'd like to see the doctor.' while Meera, lower left, is silent. Top-right: Meera says 'Of course. May I register your details for today's appointment?' and Ravi is cut off at the left edge. Middle wide panel: Ravi says 'Yes, please.' with Meera silent on the right. Bottom: Meera says 'You're all set, Ravi. Please have a seat.' with Ravi silent on the left.
pages.observation: In panel 1 the balloon is directly above Meera's face box, so despite its long horizontal tail to Ravi it could be misread as Meera's line. Ravi is right and Meera left in panel 1, then they swap sides from panel 2 on, a reversal of positions. Meera uses Ravi's name although he never gives it on the page; the registration is skipped between 'Yes, please.' and 'You're all set', with no visual or caption bridge. The wide middle panel holds only two words.
